mainText: Hello, Verona! At 8 PM, here is today's balanced dish. It is currently 68 degrees with overcast skies near the Verona Public Library. If you are heading out, look to the northwest near Middleton and Verona High School at 9:13 PM to spot the space station for three minutes as it heads toward the northeast. Tonight, we will see an overnight low of 59 degrees with no rain in the forecast.
City Hall reports that there were no major headlines or emails for residents to be aware of during this two-week period.

There is plenty to do in town. Today, you can join trivia at Hop Haus or Wisconsin Brewing Company. Tomorrow, plan to visit the Downtown Farmer's Market at Hometown Junction Park or enjoy live music at Paddy Mac's.
The police department released a summary of calls for service covering the period from August 31st through September 14th, though no specific incidents were detailed in the report.
The Culver's of Verona location is currently closed for a remodel. We look forward to their return, and the store is scheduled to open tomorrow at 10:00 AM.
